title: toilet plunger and brush set
text: toilet plunger and brush set. Needed a new set for the guest bath. This one seemed neat and tidy and it is in my opinion.  It is as represented in the ad -it appears to be brushed stainless and black plastic.  Both heads twist on - so - you could replace them - although I didn't see any replacements offered. It is a bit smaller than I expected.  Just a note:  The plunger handle and head seems small to me, but it does work. Time will tell if it really is a good buy.  I never hesitate to update my reviews should new info seem useful and I hope the info I have provided today is helpful to you.

product_metadata.title: ToiletTree Products Modern Deluxe Freestanding Toilet Brush and Plunger Combo (Stainless Steel, Brush and Plunger Combo Set 4.5” x 9.75” x 18.5")
features: Be ready for plunging emergencies and a tidy clean-up afterward with this professional-quality plunger and toilet brush combination caddy set; the decorative matte stainless steel finish of the handles and heavy-weight double holder look stylish sitting next to your toilet bowl

This duo hideaway canister set is open in the back so the brush and plunger are always out of sight; simply lift and remove the plunger or brush from the back of the unit and slip them back under when done; it keeps the dirty work of cleaning your bowl discreetly hidden

The black rubber plunger design provides a good grip and ultimate suction power; it clears up clogs so you can flush with ease again; in just a few pumps, this well-made, strong, handy plunging tool will help clear up a backed-up toilet; you’ll be back to easy flushing in no time

As part of this unique accessory set, the well-made toilet brush with black bristles does the job of cleaning and scrubbing in the most hygienic way, with any drips landing in the covered storage holder once done

This set has a trendy look and a solid and secure stand that won’t flip or tip over when you use it, like cheap plastic plunger and brush combos do; no need to worry about water and germs all over the floor; the plunger and the brush stay firmly inside the sturdy canister, safe and secure
